cloud_references.label: Same model family in the cloud: Qwen3.8-Flash on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
cloud_references.pricing_basis: Global deployment scope (US Virginia), single tier up to 1M input tokens. US (Virginia) and International (Singapore) scopes list $0.15 / $0.47. The hosted qwen3.8-flash is the API model of the Qwen3.8-Flash family; the price list does not say it is identical to the open Qwen3.8-Flash-Next weights served on the Fury.

other_system_power_w.label: Other (non-GPU) system power during AI calls (assumption). The Fury reports module power (about 289 W idle against 142 W GPU), but the W06 sampler reads GPU power only. Enter a wall-socket meter reading minus GPU power to include it.
